headline: Binance Investigated Over Suspected $6.3 Billion Security Hack
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance is confronting what is suspected to be the largest hack in history, involving approximately $6.3 billion.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Major breaches at centralized crypto platforms create systemic counterparty risks and heighten global regulatory scrutiny.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Binance is the direct subject of a suspected multibillion-dollar security breach.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A multi-billion-dollar security breach at the world's leading crypto exchange triggers acute liquidity concerns and sharp selloffs across digital asset markets.
